storeInfo.name: The Beehive
storeInfo.tagline: Southbury's sweetest spot for artisanal bites, comforting fare, and great community vibes / El rincón más dulce de Southbury para bocados artesanales y buena compañía

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.nameEs: Pan plano con miel y queso de cabra
products.descriptionEs: Pan plano crujiente untado con queso de cabra cremoso, higos frescos, nueces tostadas y un generoso toque de miel silvestre local.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy flatbread topped with creamy goat cheese, fresh figs, toasted walnuts, and a generous drizzle of local wildflower honey.

products.descriptionEs: Alitas de pollo crujientes bañadas en nuestra salsa secreta de chile dulce y miel picante, servidas con bastones de apio y aderezo ranch.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy chicken wings tossed in our signature spicy honey and sweet chili glaze, served with celery sticks and house ranch dressing.

products.nameEs: Croquetas crujientes de trufa y parmesano
products.descriptionEs: Bocados dorados de risotto con infusión de aceite de trufa blanca y queso parmesano reggiano, acompañados de alioli de ajo.
products.descriptionEn: Golden risotto bites infused with white truffle oil and reggiano parmesan cheese, served with garlic aioli.

products.nameEs: Sopa rústica de tomate y albahaca
products.descriptionEs: Sopa cremosa de tomates asados al horno con hierbas frescas, un chorrito de aceite de oliva virgen extra y crutones de ajo crujientes.
products.descriptionEn: Creamy soup of oven-roasted tomatoes with fresh herbs, a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, and crunchy garlic croutons.

products.descriptionEs: Jugosa carne de res Angus con queso cheddar añejo, tocino ahumado crujiente, cebollas caramelizadas y nuestra salsa especial en pan brioche tostado.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy Angus beef patty with aged cheddar cheese, crispy smoked bacon, caramelized onions, and our special house sauce on a toasted brioche bun.

products.nameEs: Pechuga de pollo al sándwich de miel y mostaza
products.descriptionEn: Marinated grilled chicken breast, crisp lettuce, ripe tomato, and a tangy honey dijon glaze on artisan sourdough bread.

products.nameEs: Ensalada de col rizada, pera y nueces
products.descriptionEn: Tender baby kale massaged with lemon-honey vinaigrette, sliced Bartlett pears, crumbled gorgonzola cheese, and toasted walnuts.

products.nameEs: Pasta cremosa al pesto con pollo
products.descriptionEn: Fresh pappardelle noodles tossed in a rich basil, garlic, and pine nut pesto cream sauce, topped with tender grilled chicken strips and parmesan.

products.nameEs: Salmón glaseado con miel y chipotle
products.descriptionEn: Fresh Alaskan salmon fillet grilled with a smoky chipotle and sweet honey glaze, served with garlic mashed potatoes and sautéed asparagus.

products.nameEs: Costillas de cerdo braseadas con salsa barbacoa de la casa
products.descriptionEn: Slow-braised tender pork ribs coated in our signature honey-infused artisan BBQ sauce, served with rustic French fries.

products.nameEs: Risotto de setas silvestres y trufa
products.descriptionEn: Slow-cooked creamy Arborio rice simmered with assorted wild forest mushrooms, truffle butter, and plenty of freshly grated parmesan cheese.

products.nameEs: Limonada artesanal de lavanda y miel
products.descriptionEn: Freshly squeezed natural lemonade sweetened with local honey and subtly infused with organic lavender blossoms.

products.nameEs: Té helado de durazno y jengibre
products.descriptionEn: Freshly brewed black tea blended with sweet natural peach purée and a zesty kick of fresh ginger root.

products.nameEs: Cerveza artesanal local IPA de Connecticut
products.descriptionEn: Hazy, aromatic New England style IPA bursting with citrus hop notes, sourced directly from local Connecticut craft breweries.
Double shot of rich espresso, artisan dark chocolate, steamed milk, and a distinctive hint of pure bee honey.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con múltiples opciones vegetarianas y platos libres de gluten marcados en nuestro menú. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer multiple vegetarian options and gluten-free dishes marked on our menu. Please ask your server.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations for large parties?
faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y reservaciones por teléfono para grupos. Llámenos con anticipación.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and phone reservations for parties. Please call us ahead of time.
